messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: Load ggplot2 by default
parts:
Hello,

Is there a way to load the ggplot2 package by default when starting R?
I would imagine there is a settings file but I can't seem to find any
info on how to do this.

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: Re: Load ggplot2 by default
parts:
Use the Rprofile.site, for example
If you have R saved on your C drive like this:
C:\R\R-2.10.0\etc double click on Rprofile.site and write:
library(ggplot2) and save it. Now ggplot will be available
everytime R starts.
